verdict.rationale: Make documents an official TypeScript SDK on its client-libraries page, with type definitions, built-in error handling, and response typing over most Make API endpoints. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec also backs the API reference. missing for 10: SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript, coverage of all API endpoints rather than a majority, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Make Typescript SDK provides full support for type definitions and a majority of Make API endpoints, built-in error handling, and response typing.
